theme-data.name: jereme.dev Pro Theme
theme-data.description:
Polished, fully responsive Bludit theme for jereme.dev with first-class light & dark mode.

Special Features:

Posts placed in a category named "Archived" will not show in search results and will have an "archived" banner above the page content.

A static page whose Description field is set to 404 is hidden in search results. The page is still served at its URL — it just stops appearing in search. Set the Description to 404 on the page (usually a Static page) you want to serve as your site's not-found page.

For additional features be sure to insall the jereme-dev-companion plugin.

type-to-start-searching: Type at least 3 characters to search
